# Amin Dhouib

Personal portfolio of Amin Dhouib, CEO and CTO of Devino Solutions, an AI and software consultancy based in Ottawa, Canada. Amin is a full-stack engineer who builds products and self-hosts them on a home server. This site covers his writing, work, services, and a set of playable browser games. The base URL is https://amindhou.com.

## Blog

Long-form writing on engineering, self-hosting, open source, and building products.

- [5 Apps, 5 Lessons: What I Learned Shipping Products Nobody Asked For](https://amindhou.com/blog/5-apps-5-lessons)
- [My Full DevSecOps Pipeline: ESLint, knip, CodeRabbit, and Beyond](https://amindhou.com/blog/devsecops-pipeline)
- [From $0 to $1M: What I Learned Building Devino Solutions](https://amindhou.com/blog/devino-solutions-lessons)
- [Why I Use AI Agents to Automate My Entire Dev Workflow](https://amindhou.com/blog/ai-agents-dev-workflow)
- [Building an Open-Source Honey Alternative: The Caramel Story](https://amindhou.com/blog/caramel-open-source-story)
- [How I Self-Host Everything on a Home Server with 99.99% Uptime](https://amindhou.com/blog/self-hosting-home-server)
- [Blog index](https://amindhou.com/blog)
